selection: model75's recipe (CoAtNet-2 at 384 px, full training from ImageNet-12k/1k, encoder LR 2e-5, head LR 1e-3, warmup 10%, gradient checkpointing, GPU augmentation, plain soft-label BCE on Gemini v1, 16 windows/study, batch 8, cosine, epoch by weak-val BCE) with a NEW SEED and 18 instead of 25 epochs: model75's weak-val BCE plateaued from epoch 13 (best epoch 16), so a shorter cosine should reach the same quality for ~30% less. model75 alone scored 0.939 public (model89), our best own model; seeds of it form a CoAtNet-2 384 ensemble for the fleet leg.
